notes: S2-FIX2 U1 (decision 2026-11-15 #22; weave.erasure signer rules, S2-FIX1 Q1): a program erasure recorded at T4 whose body.basis grant is revoked by its granter effective T3, before the erasure. The basis covers the actor key, the kind and the erase action, and the validity of the grant chain at the erasure's recorded_at is judged last for every authorising grant, an agent's actor.grant and a program's or device's body.basis alike. A grant that cannot be established at that time gives the grant code: E_GRANT_REVOKED (unverifiable).
